Questions

How do the strips work?

Peel open a sachet, place the strip on your tongue and let it dissolve. No water needed.

How many strips are in a pack?

Every pack holds 30 individually wrapped strips.

Can I mix flavours?

Yes. Add any combination of Energy, Sleep, Focus and NAD+ to your cart.

How does subscribe and save work?

Choose the subscription option and a new pack ships every three months at a lower price. Placeholder terms.

Are the strips right for me?

Ask your doctor or pharmacist if you are pregnant, nursing, taking medication or have a medical condition. Placeholder copy.
